text:
cheng: Heads-up  follow-up thread from the postmortem earlier: recurring cross-region retry storm between us-east1 <-> eu-west1. Observed: backend ejects, TLS handshake resets, and traffic flaps around 02:05-02:45 UTC. We need owners and timelines for remediation.

maria: can we have a 3-line exec-ready RCA we can paste into the summary?

cheng: short RCA bullets:
- healthcheck flaps caused edge LB to eject healthy-ish backends under burst
- during failover we saw TLS alert (handshake_failure, fatal 40) on a subset of flows
- likely correlated with route selection bouncing traffic across regions after the routing tweak last week
- hypothesis: proxy is mangling SNI or dropping ALPN during connection reuse -> causes some resets

sam: is this definitely new since the 172f2b3 routing change? anyone compared pre/post metrics?

jordan: I ran distribution diffs: inter-region bursts went up ~18% during peak windows post-change. matches incident timing. logged in ops notes.

priya: propose remediation slate:
- immediate: increase healthcheck grace + lower eject sensitivity (owner: sam)
- near-term: add TLS handshake_failure metric, alerting and a synthetic cross-region probe (owner: maria)
- longer-term: integration test for ALPN/SNI pass-through and proxy TLS handshake tracing (owner: cheng)
Can owners confirm ETAs?

sam: I'll push the config tweak. ETA: apply in ~2h, then 24h watch window. I'll post the exact config diff when done.

maria: alert/dashboard  I can deliver the alert and a Grafana panel in 1 business day. will wire a synthetic probe across regions.

cheng: infra work for long-term test  need infra support for test harness and certs. ETA: 2w to scope + build, +1w for rollout. I'll loop infra.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: sam -> lb-config ops/v2026-03-24-ejects at 2026-03-24T11:05:00Z :rocket:

sam: applying tweak now. commands:```
rlbctl apply --file lb-ejects-tweak.yml --pool edge-lb1
kubectl annotate deployment edge-proxy rollout=manual
```
I'll tail healthcheck/eject metrics.

maria: for paging: suggest page @network-oncall only for >5% handshake_failure sustained over 5m, otherwise slack notify. good?

cheng: agreed. also action: update the original postmortem doc with these owners/timelines. priya, can you own updating the doc and adding an incident follow-up checklist?

priya: yep, I'll update the postmortem and add a recurring check on the monthly incident review board for SNI/ALPN regressions.

sam: early numbers: eject rate down ~55% in the 30m after tweak. handshake_failure spikes reduced but still present occasionally. continuing to monitor.

jordan: uploaded packet captures and a filtered TLS trace to gs://redwood-ops/incident-captures/2092010000/ for deep-dive.

cheng: next checkpoints:
- sam to post stability report by 2092013600 (~1h)
- maria to share dashboard link by 2092890000 (~1d)
- cheng/infra to produce integration test scope by 2093410000 (~2w)
If anything regresses reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
